summary: The customer called because their internet was down and they were frustrated about missing work. The agent identified an unexpected fiber outage in the area, apologized, and offered a service credit along with 50 gigabytes of mobile data for hotspotting. The customer accepted the temporary fix while expressing ongoing dissatisfaction.

evidence.text: However, I can credit your account for today's downtime and push 50 gigabytes of mobile data to your phone right now so you can hotspot your computer.
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Credit the customer's account for downtime and add 50GB of mobile data.

evidence.text: I understand you are angry, but a manager will tell you the exact same thing regarding the physical repair.
evidence.speaker: Agent

compliance_flags.description: The agent initially resisted or argued against transferring the customer to a manager, which violates standard escalation procedures.

evidence.text: I am very sorry for the frustration, I can certainly check the status of the network in your area for you.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent maintained composure throughout the call despite the customer's anger, though slightly stumbled by pushing back on the manager request.

evidence.text: I completely understand your frustration, Mr. Davis.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent acknowledged the customer's frustration and personalized the response by using their name.

evidence.text: However, I can credit your account for today's downtime and push 50 gigabytes of mobile data to your phone right now so you can hotspot your computer.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent provided a practical immediate workaround (mobile data) and compensation (account credit) to solve the customer's immediate problem.

evidence.text: Our technicians are already on-site working to repair a damaged cable, and the estimated restoration time is currently set for another two hours.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The explanation of the cause of the outage and the estimated time to repair was clear and direct.

evidence.text: Fine, just do that immediately so I can get back online, but I expect a much larger credit on my next bill for this disaster.
evidence.speaker: Customer

rubric_scores.justification: The call ended abruptly with the customer demanding action, and the agent failed to properly close or confirm satisfaction.

evidence.text: I am looking at your address now, and I do see there is an unexpected fiber outage reported in your neighborhood as of 1:00 PM.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent accurately pulled up account and neighborhood network status information.

evidence.text: May I have your account number or phone number, please?
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent verified the customer's account, but mishandled the escalation policy by refusing the manager request.

quote.text: My internet has been completely dead for the last three hours, and I work from home! This is completely unacceptable!
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: And I don't want excuses, I want to know why I'm paying full price for a service that never works when I actually need it!
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: Two hours?! That is ridiculous! I am losing money by the minute because of your faulty equipment! I demand to speak to a manager right now!
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: Fine, just do that immediately so I can get back online, but I expect a much larger credit on my next bill for this disaster.
quote.speaker: Customer
